title: The goddess who almost wiped out humanity… and they stopped her with beer
cover:
She almost wiped out humanity.
They stopped her with beer

scenes.text: This goddess almost wiped out humanity. And they stopped her… with beer.
Look up Hathor: goddess of love and music. But that label was stuck on her by the Greeks.
In the Egyptian text, carved in the tomb of Seti the First, Ra has grown old. And humans mock him: bones of silver, flesh of gold, hair of lapis lazuli.
So Ra sends out his Eye: Hathor. She hunts the blasphemers through the mountains, and kills them all.
For three nights, now as Hathor Sekhmet, she wades in the blood of men.
Ra regrets it, and sets a trap: seven thousand jars of beer, dyed red, poured out over the fields.
Hathor drinks, gets very merry, falls asleep. And kills no more.
Ever after, at every festival of Hathor, they brewed sleepy beer.
Some call this a flood myth. But the only thing flooding the fields… is beer.
Before you believe a myth, always ask: which text says so?
Save it, and send it to anyone who thinks Hathor was just the goddess of love.
